verses.original: Ταῦτα εἰπὼν Ἰησοῦς ἐξῆλθεν σὺν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ πέραν τοῦ χειμάρρου τοῦ Κέδρων ὅπου ἦν κῆπος εἰς ὃν εἰσῆλθεν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tauta eipōn Iēsous exēlthen syn tois mathētais autou peran tou cheimarrou tou Kedrōn hopou ēn kēpos eis hon eisēlthen autos kai hoi mathētai autou
verses.literal: After Jesus had spoken these words He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley where they entered . . . a garden
verses.literalPt: TENDO Jesus dito isto, saiu com os seus discípulos para além do ribeiro de Cedrom, onde havia um horto, no qual ele entrou e seus discípulos.

verses.original: ᾔδει δὲ καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν τὸν τόπον ὅτι πολλάκις συνήχθη Ἰησοῦς ἐκεῖ μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ēdei de kai Ioudas ho paradidous auton ton topon hoti pollakis synēchthē Iēsous ekei meta tōn mathētōn autou
verses.literal: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place because Jesus had often met there with His disciples
verses.literalPt: E Judas, que o traía, também conhecia aquele lugar, porque Jesus muitas vezes se ajuntava ali com os seus discípulos.

verses.original: ὁ οὖν Ἰούδας λαβὼν τὴν σπεῖραν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων ὑπηρέτας ἔρχεται ἐκεῖ μετὰ φανῶν καὶ λαμπάδων καὶ ὅπλων
verses.transliteration: ho oun Ioudas labōn tēn speiran kai ek tōn archiereōn kai ek tōn Pharisaiōn hypēretas erchetai ekei meta phanōn kai lampadōn kai hoplōn
verses.literal: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and - Pharisees They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns torches and weapons
verses.literalPt: Tendo, pois, Judas recebido a coorte e oficiais dos principais sacerdotes e fariseus, veio para ali com lanternas, e archotes e armas.

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς οὖν εἰδὼς πάντα τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἐξῆλθεν καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Τίνα ζητεῖτε
verses.transliteration: Iēsous oun eidōs panta ta erchomena ep’ auton exēlthen kai legei autois Tina zēteite
verses.literal: Jesus knowing all that was coming upon Him stepped forward and asked them Whom are you seeking
verses.literalPt: Sabendo, pois, Jesus todas as coisas que sobre ele haviam de vir, adiantou-se, e disse-lhes: A quem buscais?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον Λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἐγώ εἰμι Εἱστήκει δὲ καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν μετ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan autō Iēsoun ton Nazōraion Legei autois Egō eimi Heistēkei de kai Ioudas ho paradidous auton met’ autōn
verses.literal: Jesus of Nazareth they answered Jesus said I am He And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them
verses.literalPt: Responderam-lhe: A Jesus Nazareno. Disse-lhes Jesus: Sou eu. E Judas, que o traía, estava com eles.

verses.original: ὡς οὖν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐγώ εἰμι ἀπῆλθον εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ ἔπεσαν χαμαί
verses.transliteration: hōs oun eipen autois Egō eimi apēlthon eis ta opisō kai epesan chamai
verses.literal: When Jesus said I am He they drew . . . back and fell to the ground
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, lhes disse: Sou eu, recuaram, e caíram por terra.

verses.original: Πάλιν οὖν ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτούς Τίνα ζητεῖτε Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον
verses.transliteration: Palin oun epērōtēsen autous Tina zēteite Hoi de eipan Iēsoun ton Nazōraion
verses.literal: So He asked them again Whom are you seeking Jesus of Nazareth - they answered
verses.literalPt: Tornou-lhes, pois, a perguntar: A quem buscais? E eles disseram: A Jesus Nazareno.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Εἶπον ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι εἰ οὖν ἐμὲ ζητεῖτε ἄφετε τούτους ὑπάγειν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous Eipon hymin hoti egō eimi ei oun eme zēteite aphete toutous hypagein
verses.literal: I told you that I am He Jesus replied So if you are looking for Me let these men go
verses.literalPt: Jesus respondeu: Já vos disse que sou eu; se, pois, me buscais a mim, deixai ir estes;

verses.original: ἵνα πληρωθῇ ὁ λόγος ὃν εἶπεν ὅτι Οὓς δέδωκάς μοι οὐκ ἀπώλεσα ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδένα
verses.transliteration: hina plērōthē ho logos hon eipen hoti Hous dedōkas moi ouk apōlesa ex autōn oudena
verses.literal: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken I have not lost one . . . of those You have given Me
verses.literalPt: Para que se cumprisse a palavra que tinha dito: Dos que me deste nenhum deles perdi.

verses.original: Σίμων οὖν Πέτρος ἔχων μάχαιραν εἵλκυσεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔπαισεν τὸν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως δοῦλον καὶ ἀπέκοψεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτάριον τὸ δεξιόν ἦν δὲ ὄνομα τῷ δούλῳ Μάλχος
verses.transliteration: Simōn oun Petros echōn machairan heilkysen autēn kai epaisen ton tou archiereōs doulon kai apekopsen autou to ōtarion to dexion ēn de onoma tō doulō Malchos
verses.literal: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest cutting off his right ear The servant’s name was Malchus
verses.literalPt: Então Simão Pedro, que tinha espada, desembainhou-a, e feriu o servo do sumo sacerdote, cortando-lhe a orelha direita. E o nome do servo era Malco.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ Πέτρῳ Βάλε τὴν μάχαιραν εἰς τὴν θήκην τὸ ποτήριον ὃ δέδωκέν μοι ὁ Πατήρ οὐ μὴ πίω αὐτό
verses.transliteration: eipen oun ho Iēsous tō Petrō Bale tēn machairan eis tēn thēkēn to potērion ho dedōken moi ho Patēr ou mē piō auto
verses.literal: Put your sword back in its sheath - Jesus said to Peter Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me
verses.literalPt: Mas Jesus disse a Pedro: Põe a tua espada na bainha; não beberei eu o cálice que o Pai me deu?

verses.original: Ἡ οὖν σπεῖρα καὶ ὁ χιλίαρχος καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται τῶν Ἰουδαίων συνέλαβον τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἔδησαν αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Hē oun speira kai ho chiliarchos kai hoi hypēretai tōn Ioudaiōn synelabon ton Iēsoun kai edēsan auton
verses.literal: Then the band of soldiers with its commander and the officers of the Jews arrested Jesus and bound Him
verses.literalPt: Então a coorte, e o tribuno, e os servos dos judeus prenderam a Jesus e o maniataram.

verses.original: καὶ ἤγαγον πρὸς Ἅνναν πρῶτον ἦν γὰρ πενθερὸς τοῦ Καϊάφα ὃς ἦν ἀρχιερεὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐκείνου
verses.transliteration: kai ēgagon pros Hannan prōton ēn gar pentheros tou Kaiapha hos ēn archiereus tou eniautou ekeinou
verses.literal: They brought Him first . . . to Annas who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas - the high priest that year
verses.literalPt: E conduziram-no primeiramente a Anás, por ser sogro de Caifás, que era o sumo sacerdote daquele ano.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ Καϊάφας ὁ συμβουλεύσας τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι συμφέρει ἕνα ἄνθρωπον ἀποθανεῖν ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαοῦ
verses.transliteration: ēn de Kaiaphas ho symbouleusas tois Ioudaiois hoti sympherei hena anthrōpon apothanein hyper tou laou
verses.literal: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man died for the people
verses.literalPt: Ora, Caifás era quem tinha aconselhado aos judeus que convinha que um homem morresse pelo povo.

verses.original: Ἠκολούθει δὲ τῷ Ἰησοῦ Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ ἄλλος μαθητής ὁ δὲ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος ἦν γνωστὸς τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ καὶ συνεισῆλθεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως
verses.transliteration: Ēkolouthei de tō Iēsou Simōn Petros kai allos mathētēs ho de mathētēs ekeinos ēn gnōstos tō archierei kai syneisēlthen tō Iēsou eis tēn aulēn tou archiereōs
verses.literal: Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus Since that disciple was known to the high priest he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest
verses.literalPt: E Simão Pedro e outro discípulo seguiam a Jesus. E este discípulo era conhecido do sumo sacerdote, e entrou com Jesus na sala do sumo sacerdote.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος εἱστήκει πρὸς τῇ θύρᾳ ἔξω ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ μαθητὴς ὁ ἄλλος ὁ γνωστὸς τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ εἶπεν τῇ θυρωρῷ καὶ εἰσήγαγεν τὸν Πέτρον
verses.transliteration: ho de Petros heistēkei pros tē thyra exō exēlthen oun ho mathētēs ho allos ho gnōstos tou archiereōs kai eipen tē thyrōrō kai eisēgagen ton Petron
verses.literal: But Peter stood outside at the door Then the - disciple who was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper and brought Peter in
verses.literalPt: E Pedro estava da parte de fora, à porta. Saiu então o outro discípulo que era conhecido do sumo sacerdote, e falou à porteira, levando Pedro para dentro.

verses.original: Λέγει οὖν τῷ Πέτρῳ ἡ παιδίσκη ἡ θυρωρός Μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν εἶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου Λέγει ἐκεῖνος Οὐκ εἰμί
verses.transliteration: Legei oun tō Petrō hē paidiskē hē thyrōros Mē kai sy ek tōn mathētōn ei tou anthrōpou toutou Legei ekeinos Ouk eimi
verses.literal: At this the servant girl watching the door said to Peter Aren’t . . . you also one of - this man’s disciples I am not he answered
verses.literalPt: Então a porteira disse a Pedro: Não és tu também dos discípulos deste homem? Disse ele: Não sou.

verses.original: Εἱστήκεισαν δὲ οἱ δοῦλοι καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται ἀνθρακιὰν πεποιηκότες ὅτι ψῦχος ἦν καὶ ἐθερμαίνοντο ἦν δὲ καὶ ὁ Πέτρος μετ’ αὐτῶν ἑστὼς καὶ θερμαινόμενος
verses.transliteration: Heistēkeisan de hoi douloi kai hoi hypēretai anthrakian pepoiēkotes hoti psychos ēn kai ethermainonto ēn de kai ho Petros met’ autōn hestōs kai thermainomenos
verses.literal: Because it was cold the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm And Peter was also standing with them warming himself
verses.literalPt: Ora, estavam ali os servos e os servidores, que tinham feito brasas, e se aquentavam, porque fazia frio; e com eles estava Pedro, aquentando-se também.

verses.original: Ὁ οὖν ἀρχιερεὺς ἠρώτησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν περὶ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ τῆς διδαχῆς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho oun archiereus ērōtēsen ton Iēsoun peri tōn mathētōn autou kai peri tēs didachēs autou
verses.literal: Meanwhile the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching
verses.literalPt: E o sumo sacerdote interrogou Jesus acerca dos seus discípulos e da sua doutrina.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς Ἐγὼ παρρησίᾳ λελάληκα τῷ κόσμῳ ἐγὼ πάντοτε ἐδίδαξα ἐν συναγωγῇ καὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ὅπου πάντες οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι συνέρχονται καὶ ἐν κρυπτῷ ἐλάλησα οὐδέν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autō Iēsous Egō parrēsia lelalēka tō kosmō egō pantote edidaxa en synagōgē kai en tō hierō hopou pantes hoi Ioudaioi synerchontai kai en kryptō elalēsa ouden
verses.literal: I have spoken openly to the world Jesus answered I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple where all the Jews come together I said nothing in secret
verses.literalPt: Jesus lhe respondeu: Eu falei abertamente ao mundo; eu sempre ensinei na sinagoga e no templo, onde os judeus sempre se ajuntam, e nada disse em oculto.

verses.original: τί με ἐρωτᾷς ἐρώτησον τοὺς ἀκηκοότας τί ἐλάλησα αὐτοῖς ἴδε οὗτοι οἴδασιν ἃ εἶπον ἐγώ
verses.transliteration: ti me erōtas erōtēson tous akēkootas ti elalēsa autois ide houtoi oidasin ha eipon egō
verses.literal: Why are you asking Me Ask those who heard My message . . . Surely they know what I said
verses.literalPt: Para que me perguntas a mim? Pergunta aos que ouviram o que é que lhes ensinei; eis que eles sabem o que eu lhes tenho dito.

verses.original: Ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ εἰπόντος εἷς παρεστηκὼς τῶν ὑπηρετῶν ἔδωκεν ῥάπισμα τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰπών Οὕτως ἀποκρίνῃ τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ
verses.transliteration: Tauta de autou eipontos heis parestēkōs tōn hypēretōn edōken rhapisma tō Iēsou eipōn Houtōs apokrinē tō archierei
verses.literal: When Jesus had said this one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face . . . . . . and said Is this how You answer the high priest
verses.literalPt: E, tendo dito isto, um dos servidores que ali estavam, deu uma bofetada em Jesus, dizendo: Assim respondes ao sumo sacerdote?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς Εἰ κακῶς ἐλάλησα μαρτύρησον περὶ τοῦ κακοῦ εἰ δὲ καλῶς τί με δέρεις
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autō Iēsous Ei kakōs elalēsa martyrēson peri tou kakou ei de kalōs ti me dereis
verses.literal: Jesus replied If I said something wrong testify as to what was wrong But if I spoke correctly why did you strike Me
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Se falei mal, dá testemunho do mal; e, se bem, por que me feres?

verses.original: Ἀπέστειλεν οὖν αὐτὸν ὁ Ἅννας δεδεμένον πρὸς Καϊάφαν τὸν ἀρχιερέα
verses.transliteration: Apesteilen oun auton ho Hannas dedemenon pros Kaiaphan ton archierea
verses.literal: Then Annas sent Him still bound to Caiaphas the high priest
verses.literalPt: E Anás mandou-o, maniatado, ao sumo sacerdote Caifás.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ Σίμων Πέτρος ἑστὼς καὶ θερμαινόμενος εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ Μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶ Ἠρνήσατο ἐκεῖνος καὶ εἶπεν Οὐκ εἰμί
verses.transliteration: Ēn de Simōn Petros hestōs kai thermainomenos eipon oun autō Mē kai sy ek tōn mathētōn autou ei Ērnēsato ekeinos kai eipen Ouk eimi
verses.literal: Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself So they asked him Aren’t . . . you also one of His disciples He denied it and said I am not
verses.literalPt: E Simão Pedro estava ali, e aquentava-se. Disseram-lhe, pois: Não és também tu um dos seus discípulos? Ele negou, e disse: Não sou.

verses.original: Λέγει εἷς ἐκ τῶν δούλων τοῦ ἀρχιερέως συγγενὴς ὢν οὗ ἀπέκοψεν Πέτρος τὸ ὠτίον Οὐκ ἐγώ σε εἶδον ἐν τῷ κήπῳ μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Legei heis ek tōn doulōn tou archiereōs syngenēs ōn hou apekopsen Petros to ōtion Ouk egō se eidon en tō kēpō met’ autou
verses.literal: One of the high priest’s servants a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off asked Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden
verses.literalPt: E um dos servos do sumo sacerdote, parente daquele a quem Pedro cortara a orelha, disse: Não te vi eu no horto com ele?

verses.original: Πάλιν οὖν ἠρνήσατο Πέτρος καὶ εὐθέως ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν
verses.transliteration: Palin oun ērnēsato Petros kai eutheōs alektōr ephōnēsen
verses.literal: Peter denied it once more and immediately a rooster crowed
verses.literalPt: E Pedro negou outra vez, e logo o galo cantou.

verses.original: Ἄγουσιν οὖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ Καϊάφα εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον ἦν δὲ πρωΐ καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐκ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον ἵνα μὴ μιανθῶσιν ἀλλὰ φάγωσιν τὸ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: Agousin oun ton Iēsoun apo tou Kaiapha eis to praitōrion ēn de prōi kai autoi ouk eisēlthon eis to praitōrion hina mē mianthōsin alla phagōsin to pascha
verses.literal: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium By now it was early morning and the Jews did not enter . . . the Praetorium to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover
verses.literalPt: Depois levaram Jesus da casa de Caifás para a audiência. E era pela manhã cedo. E não entraram na audiência, para não se contaminarem, mas poderem comer a páscoa.

verses.original: Ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἔξω πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ φησίν Τίνα κατηγορίαν φέρετε κατὰ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου
verses.transliteration: Exēlthen oun ho Pilatos exō pros autous kai phēsin Tina katēgorian pherete kata tou anthrōpou toutou
verses.literal: So Pilate went out to them and asked What accusation are you bringing against this man
verses.literalPt: Então Pilatos saiu fora e disse-lhes: Que acusação trazeis contra este homem?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Εἰ μὴ ἦν οὗτος κακὸν ποιῶν οὐκ ἄν σοι παρεδώκαμεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan kai eipan autō Ei mē ēn houtos kakon poiōn ouk an soi paredōkamen auton
verses.literal: If He were not a criminal they replied . . . . . . . . . we would not have handed Him over . . . to you
verses.literalPt: Responderam, e disseram-lhe: Se este não fosse malfeitor, não to entregaríamos.

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος Λάβετε αὐτὸν ὑμεῖς καὶ κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὑμῶν κρίνατε αὐτόν Εἶπον αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Ἡμῖν οὐκ ἔξεστιν ἀποκτεῖναι οὐδένα
verses.transliteration: Eipen oun autois ho Pilatos Labete auton hymeis kai kata ton nomon hymōn krinate auton Eipon autō hoi Ioudaioi Hēmin ouk exestin apokteinai oudena
verses.literal: You take Him and judge Him by your own law - Pilate told them We are not permitted . . . to execute anyone . . . the Jews replied
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes, pois, Pilatos: Levai-o vós, e julgai-o segundo a vossa lei. Disseram-lhe então os judeus: A nós não nos é lícito matar pessoa alguma.

verses.original: ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ πληρωθῇ ὃν εἶπεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ ἤμελλεν ἀποθνήσκειν
verses.transliteration: hina ho logos tou Iēsou plērōthē hon eipen sēmainōn poiō thanatō ēmellen apothnēskein
verses.literal: This was to fulfill the word that Jesus had spoken to indicate the kind of death He was going to die
verses.literalPt: (Para que se cumprisse a palavra que Jesus tinha dito, significando de que morte havia de morrer).

verses.original: Εἰσῆλθεν οὖν πάλιν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον ὁ Πιλᾶτος καὶ ἐφώνησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: Eisēlthen oun palin eis to praitōrion ho Pilatos kai ephōnēsen ton Iēsoun kai eipen autō Sy ei ho Basileus tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: Pilate went back into the Praetorium summoned Jesus and asked Him Are You the King of the Jews
verses.literalPt: Tornou, pois, a entrar Pilatos na audiência, e chamou a Jesus, e disse-lhe: Tu és o Rei dos Judeus?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Ἀπὸ σεαυτοῦ σὺ τοῦτο λέγεις ἢ ἄλλοι εἶπόν σοι περὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous Apo seautou sy touto legeis ē alloi eipon soi peri emou
verses.literal: Are you saying this on your own Jesus asked or did others tell you about Me
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Tu dizes isso de ti mesmo, ou disseram-to outros de mim?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Πιλᾶτος Μήτι ἐγὼ Ἰουδαῖός εἰμι τὸ ἔθνος τὸ σὸν καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς παρέδωκάν σε ἐμοί τί ἐποίησας
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē ho Pilatos Mēti egō Ioudaios eimi to ethnos to son kai hoi archiereis paredōkan se emoi ti epoiēsas
verses.literal: Am . . . I a Jew Pilate replied Your own people and chief priests handed You over to me What have You done
verses.literalPt: Pilatos respondeu: Porventura sou eu judeu? A tua nação e os principais dos sacerdotes entregaram-te a mim. Que fizeste?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου εἰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἦν ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμή οἱ ὑπηρέται ἄν οἱ ἐμοὶ ἠγωνίζοντο ἵνα μὴ παραδοθῶ τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις νῦν δὲ ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐντεῦθεν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous Hē basileia hē emē ouk estin ek tou kosmou toutou ei ek tou kosmou toutou ēn hē basileia hē emē hoi hypēretai an hoi emoi ēgōnizonto hina mē paradothō tois Ioudaiois nyn de hē basileia hē emē ouk estin enteuthen
verses.literal: Jesus answered My kingdom is not of this world if it were - - My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews But now My kingdom is not of this realm
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jesus: O meu reino não é deste mundo; se o meu reino fosse deste mundo, pelejariam os meus servos, para que eu não fosse entregue aos judeus; mas agora o meu reino não é daqui.

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Πιλᾶτος Οὐκοῦν βασιλεὺς εἶ σύ Ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς Σὺ λέγεις ὅτι βασιλεύς εἰμι ἐγὼ εἰς τοῦτο γεγέννημαι καὶ εἰς τοῦτο ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα μαρτυρήσω τῇ ἀληθείᾳ πᾶς ὁ ὢν ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας ἀκούει μου τῆς φωνῆς
verses.transliteration: Eipen oun autō ho Pilatos Oukoun basileus ei sy Apekrithē ho Iēsous Sy legeis hoti basileus eimi egō eis touto gegennēmai kai eis touto elēlytha eis ton kosmon hina martyrēsō tē alētheia pas ho ōn ek tēs alētheias akouei mou tēs phōnēs
verses.literal: Then You are a king - Pilate said You say that I am a king Jesus answered For this reason I was born and - have come into the world to testify to the truth Everyone who belongs to . . . the truth listens to My voice
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe, pois, Pilatos: Logo tu és rei? Jesus respondeu: Tu dizes que eu sou rei. Eu para isso nasci, e para isso vim ao mundo, a fim de dar testemunho da verdade. Todo aquele que é da verdade ouve a minha voz.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πιλᾶτος Τί ἐστιν ἀλήθεια Καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν πάλιν ἐξῆλθεν πρὸς τοὺς Ἰουδαίους καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἐγὼ οὐδεμίαν εὑρίσκω ἐν αὐτῷ αἰτίαν
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Pilatos Ti estin alētheia Kai touto eipōn palin exēlthen pros tous Ioudaious kai legei autois Egō oudemian heuriskō en autō aitian
verses.literal: What is truth Pilate asked And having said this he went out again to the Jews and told them I find no basis for a charge against Him
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Pilatos: Que é a verdade? E, dizendo isto, tornou a ir ter com os judeus, e disse-lhes: Não acho nele crime algum.

verses.original: ἔστιν δὲ συνήθεια ὑμῖν ἵνα ἕνα ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ πάσχα βούλεσθε οὖν ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν τὸν Βασιλέα τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: estin de synētheia hymin hina hena apolysō hymin en tō pascha boulesthe oun apolysō hymin ton Basilea tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover So then do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews
verses.literalPt: Mas vós tendes por costume que eu vos solte alguém pela páscoa. Quereis, pois, que vos solte o Rei dos Judeus?

verses.original: Ἐκραύγασαν οὖν πάλιν λέγοντες Μὴ τοῦτον ἀλλὰ τὸν Βαραββᾶν ἦν δὲ ὁ Βαραββᾶς λῃστής
verses.transliteration: Ekraugasan oun palin legontes Mē touton alla ton Barabban ēn de ho Barabbas lēstēs
verses.literal: Not this man they shouted - but Barabbas ( Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist
verses.literalPt: Então todos tornaram a clamar, dizendo: Este não, mas Barrabás. E Barrabás era um salteador.
